role: Pure decision layer for automatic overnight sleep refresh (RRCollector+Reanalysis): whether a session may be refreshed, whether fresh HealthKit sleep should update/rescore, and how to apply it to the session's snapshot and ms boundaries.
types: SleepRefreshPolicy.SleepRefreshVerdict: struct — shouldUpdate/needsRescore and logged numbers

units.does: Returns false (and logs) when the session is user-adjusted AND already has a sleep snapshot; true otherwise (including user-adjusted sessions with nil snapshot pulled from CloudKit).

branches.effect: returns true; otherwise logs 'skipped — user-adjusted sleep' and returns false

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md §13.2 says autoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved 'Skips entirely when session.sleepUserAdjusted == true', but the guard lets a user-adjusted session with a nil sleepSnapshot through (CloudKit-pulled case) and applyAutoRefresh then fills its snapshot.

units.does: Computes the refresh verdict: prior/new night minutes, endMovedLater (>60 s), firstSnapshot (prior minutes 0), onset move (>=15 min material) and source upgrade to watch; shouldUpdate = first || endLater || more minutes || onset moved || upgrade; needsRescore = first || |delta| >= 20 || onset moved || upgrade.

branches.effect: priorEnd = distantPast, so any fresh sleepEnd counts as moved later

flags.text: A prior snapshot with 0 night minutes (an earlier empty snapshot) is treated as firstSnapshot and always forces update + rescore, identical to no snapshot.

docs/FLOWCHART.md §13.2 gives the rescore threshold as '≥ 20 min or first snapshot'; the code also rescores on an onset move >= 15 min and on a source upgrade to HealthKit/hrValidated, and the update gate also passes on those, so the doc under-describes when scores change.

units.does: Absolute difference in minutes between the session's stored sleepStartMs and the fresh sleepStart's ms offset from session start (clamped >= 0); 0 when either is missing.
True when the prior snapshot boundary source is nil/hrEstimated/healthKitHREstimated/recordingBounds AND the fresh source is healthKit or hrValidated.
Applies a refresh: user-adjusted sessions get applyPulledSleep (snapshot + fill nil boundaries only), others applyFreshSleep (overwrite snapshot, boundaries, segments).

Overwrites session.sleepSnapshot with fresh, sets sleepStartMs (clamped >= 0) and sleepEndMs from fresh boundaries when present, and sets sleepSegments to ms ranges for multi-segment nights or nil for single-segment nights.

branches.effect: sleepStartMs replaced; otherwise old value kept
sleepEndMs replaced; otherwise old value kept
sleepSegments = nil and return; otherwise mapped to SleepSegmentMs array

flags.text: sleepStartMs is clamped to >= 0 but sleepEndMs is not; a fresh sleepEnd before session start writes a negative end offset while start is clamped to 0.

units.does: Sets session.sleepSnapshot and fills sleepStartMs/sleepEndMs only when they are currently nil; never touches segments or existing boundaries.

branches.cond: sleepStartMs nil and resolved sleepStart present
sleepEndMs nil and resolved sleepEnd present
